name: Emberwake
tagline: A first-person, retro pixel-3D adventure. Clear nine dungeons, collect eight Ember Shards, unmake the Hollow King.
controls: WASD move, mouse look, click or Space attack, right-click or E item, M map, Esc menu. Gamepads work too.
howToJoin: Host opens Menu, then Invite Friends, which shows a 5-character code.
Friends pick Join a Friend and type the code, or open the invite link.
If the code won't connect, everyone joins the same hotspot or Wi-Fi and uses the webcam QR option on both sides.
author: MLMecham

name: Dot Slayer
tagline: Fast browser arena game with room-code co-op for up to four players. Plays on phones too.
howToJoin: Host starts a room and gets a room code.
Friends open the game and enter the code.
author: Logan-Lay21

name: Own the Night
tagline: Night-time 3D street racing with up to six players. Eight cars, four neighborhoods, five weather settings, handbrake drifts and competitive AI.
controls: WASD or arrows to drive, Space handbrake, Shift nitro, P autopilot, R recover to last checkpoint, Esc pause. On phones, use the on-screen GAS, BRAKE, steer, H-BRAKE and N₂O buttons.
howToJoin: Host picks a car, map and weather, opens MULTIPLAYER and clicks CREATE ROOM to get a 5-character code.
Friends pick their cars, open MULTIPLAYER, enter the code and click JOIN.
When everyone is in, the host clicks START ROOM RACE. AI fills any empty seats.
Can't connect? Make sure everyone is on the same Wi-Fi or hotspot and the host keeps the game open.
author: Soroosh-N

name: Bastion: Powder & Colors
tagline: Gunpowder-era tower defense. Build musket strongholds, grenadiers, mortars and cannons on hills and roads, and hold the line against ever-tougher regiments.
controls: Click open ground or hills to build. Click a defense to upgrade it (three levels) or sell it for 70%. Space pauses, Esc deselects, and the Speed button toggles 2x.
howToJoin: Single player for now, so pass the mouse around and compare scores.
Pick a season. Each one changes visibility, reach and marching speed for the whole campaign.
You get 12 seconds to build before the first regiment arrives, then a new wave every 25 to 30 seconds. Hold out with your 20 lives.
author: Soroosh-N
